The files in this directory are the unmodified `dist/` builds from the npm
package `gsap@3.15.1`:

    gsap.min.js
    ScrollTrigger.min.js
    SplitText.min.js

Each carries its own notice in its header:

    ! GSAP 3.15.1 | https://gsap.com
    @license Copyright 2026, GreenSock. All rights reserved.
    Subject to the terms at https://gsap.com/standard-license.

The licence is GreenSock's standard "no charge" licence — the value of the
`license` field in that package's `package.json`, and the licence under which
GSAP, including every plugin, has been free for commercial and non-commercial
use since 3.13 (April 2025). The package does not redistribute the licence
text; the terms are the ones at the URL above, and they are not restated here
because a paraphrase of a licence is not a licence.

Nothing in this directory is a CDN copy, a fork, or a build of our own: the
files are committed so the site makes no third-party request, and they are only
served to pages that ask for motion in their front matter.
